question: Does model-specific vertical co-design across GLM architecture, representation, kernels, serving, memory hierarchy, and eventual hardware materially reduce quality- and SLO-adjusted inference dollars per token relative to tuned general stacks and providers?
scope: GLM-4.7-Flash complete BF16 H100 control and public AWQ-4bit L40S candidate under the frozen campaign 8192-input/1024-output c1/c8 workload, compact diagnostic quality suite, fixed SLO, vLLM 0.15 stock/tuned controls, and two trace-guided runtime interventions.

result.reason: Public AWQ on L40S passes paired diagnostic quality and fixed SLOs and reaches a best measured 355.772 output tok/s at derived $0.670000/M output tokens, but both BF16 and AWQ fail the absolute compact quality gate. The provider comparison is unmatched. FP16 regresses, the trace-selected 64-token MLA tile is first infeasible and then regresses after a feasible one-stage repair, so no custom software/model co-design gain has been measured.

derived_not_provider_matched.interpretation: Representation plus hardware/rate result on matched campaign geometry only; not a delivered provider, general quality, or custom co-design claim.

missing_evidence: absolute quality-passing BF16 and candidate control
matched Fireworks and Baseten workload, quality, availability, TTFT, TPOT, and price evidence
a custom component with a material reproducible improvement beyond public AWQ and hardware placement
holdout replication for any future material candidate

exact_next_experiment.name: standalone_exact_shape_glm_mla_decode_autotune
exact_next_experiment.method: Build a correctness-checked standalone microbenchmark from vLLM's pinned Triton grouped MLA decode kernel using GLM's exact 20-head, 512-rank latent, 256-value, long-context shapes. Sweep only hardware-legal BLOCK_H, BLOCK_N, num_warps, num_stages, and KV-split configurations on one L40S, with stock source as control. Promote only a >=10% kernel improvement that predicts >=5% end-to-end c8 and then survives one full-server holdout.
exact_next_experiment.information_value: Separates kernel parameter search from model load, quality, and serving setup; cheaply falsifies hardware legality and local kernel speed before another full allocation; directly targets the largest trace family.
exact_next_experiment.kill_condition: Stop the custom MLA lineage if no correctness-passing configuration improves the exact-shape kernel by at least 10%, or if the best legal configuration predicts less than 5% end-to-end gain.
